name: Collection hero
description: The top of a category page: breadcrumb, collection title, item count and a short intro, over a tinted band.

name: Product grid
description: A responsive 4-up grid of product cards that drops to 2-up on a tablet and 1-up on a phone.

name: Product card states
description: The four states one card has to cover side by side: default, on sale with a strike-through RRP and discount badge, sold out, and low stock. T260 on pages/commerce.html is the original single product card.

name: Product list row
description: The horizontal alternative to a card, for list-view toggles and search results: thumb left, details centre, price and CTA right.

name: Sort and result bar
description: The strip above the grid: result count, a sort select, and a grid or list view toggle.

name: Filter rail
description: The desktop faceted sidebar: collapsible details groups, checkbox facets with counts, colour swatches, a price min and max pair, and a clear-all.

name: Filter drawer
description: The mobile equivalent of the rail on a native dialog: a trigger with a count, a slide-in panel, then apply or clear.

name: Active filter chips
description: A row of removable chips showing what is narrowing the results, each with its own remove control, plus a clear-all.

name: Quick view modal
description: A dialog with product image, title, price, variant row, quantity stepper and add-to-cart, opened from a card overlay button.

name: Load more and pagination
description: Both ways to reach page two: a load-more button with a showing 24 of 96 progress line, and a numbered pagination row beneath it.

name: Empty results state
description: The no-results panel: icon, headline, explanation, the filters worth removing, and a browse-all CTA.

name: Category tiles
description: A grid of collection tiles on a wash background with a label and an item count, for a shop landing page.
